caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical, vertically oriented wooden object with a brown color. The object features geometric cut-out shapes, including multiple diamonds and curved elements. The top section consists of a large diamond-shaped opening with another diamond shape immediately below it. Moving downward, two rounded-head forms flank a smaller central diamond-shaped cut-out. The sides of the object extend downward into two vertical appendages that curve outward at the base into spiral ends, while a central pointed form extends downward between them. The overall composition is centralized on a plain, light beige background, with no additional elements or shading outside of the object itself.
title: Geometric Weather Vane
